fields.name: Transactions
fields.about: List of transactions to add partitions to.

fields.name: TransactionalId
fields.about: The transactional id corresponding to the transaction.

fields.name: ProducerId
fields.about: Current producer id in use by the transactional id.

fields.name: ProducerEpoch
fields.about: Current epoch associated with the producer id.

fields.name: VerifyOnly
fields.about: Boolean to signify if we want to check if the partition is in the transaction rather than add it.

fields.name: Topics
fields.about: The partitions to add to the transaction.

fields.name: V3AndBelowTransactionalId
fields.about: The transactional id corresponding to the transaction.

fields.name: V3AndBelowProducerId
fields.about: Current producer id in use by the transactional id.

fields.name: V3AndBelowProducerEpoch
fields.about: Current epoch associated with the producer id.

fields.name: V3AndBelowTopics
fields.about: The partitions to add to the transaction.

fields.name: Partitions
fields.about: The partition indexes to add to the transaction.
